transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Welcome to ConversalQ! How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I need to add 3 new team members to our account. We just hired them.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Happy to help! You can add team members directly from your dashboard under Settings > Team. You have 2 open seats on your current Business plan. The 3rd additional seat would be $15/month prorated.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: OK. Can I add them from there right now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes. Click 'Invite Member', enter their work email, and choose their role — Admin, Manager, or Agent. They'll receive an invitation email to set up their account.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: What's the difference between Manager and Agent roles?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Agents can handle conversations and view their own performance stats. Managers can view all agent stats, access team reports, and modify conversation assignments, but cannot change billing or account settings. Admins have full access.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Got it. Two should be Agents and one Manager. I'll set this up now. The extra $15 will just be charged to the card on file?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Correct — the prorated amount for the rest of this billing cycle will be charged to your card ending in 7891, and the full additional seat fee will apply from next month.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course! Let me know if there are any issues with the invitations. Is there anything else?
